analysis.reasonEn: RSI has exited oversold but not yet reclaimed above 50. MACD histogram is improving but still negative. Holding 5-day lows in an accumulation phase, but low volume lacks conviction. Maintaining a 'watchful' stance for the 5th consecutive day.
